title: COUPLING ENGAGED: nonzero base regen for cyclic to scale (rung-3 value) on the floor config?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: Step 3b proved the sat dial void: rate = nutrientRegen * raw/(raw+sat) with nutrientRegen = 0, so the cyclic term was 0 at every saturation and only the floor acted (prod 11/18). Rung 3 measured nutrientRegen:0.0002 alone restoring decomposers decisively. A nonzero base rate engages the coupling the last two arms only named.
preregistration.prediction: prod > 0 on at least 12/18 AND cons > 0 on at least 12/18 seeds at tick 6000 (both machine criteria). Must beat floor-alone (11/18 prod) or the concept adds nothing. Coexistence rate NOT predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if prod = 0 on 7 or more of 18 seeds: engaged cyclic coupling does not feed producers — the coupling line is abandoned entirely (no further saturation/floor/base variations blind). The program steps back to analysis. If cons = 0 on >=7/18 while producers recover, the failure is consumer viability, a separate mechanism.
preregistration.notPredicted: Coexistence rates, capture shares, extinction counts (descriptive), decomposer endpoints, bloom sizes.
confoundsControlled: Same 18-seed panel, horizon, engine, and argvRest as graze-nutcyc (cyc on, sat 1.0, floor 0.05); the ONLY difference is +nutrientRegen:0.0002 lift. Baselines against the void sat-2.0 run only through the shared sat-1.0 run
Matched comparison against the archived sat runs isolates the base-rate effect: floor-alone vs floor+engaged-cyclic
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: producers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
consumers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds
